payload.purpose_context: troupe projects keep configuration in hand-edited, reviewed YAML files split across includes. This mission delivers the configuration subsystem: loading with includes, an event-sourced record of every change persisted in the theatre, and show/set/history commands whose write-backs change only the bytes of the value being changed.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let theatre owners load, inspect, change and audit troupe configuration without disturbing their hand-edited files.

options: Files on disk are truth; set diffs against current files; no reconcile events (recommended)
Projection is truth; show ignores hand edits
payload.question: When someone hand-edits the YAML files after the theatre was imported, should show/set treat the files on disk as the source of truth (event store records only commands' changes; no reconcile events), or should the stored projection win?

payload.final_answer: A: files on disk are the source of truth; show and set always read current files; the stored projection is only the change history; hand edits appear in show but emit no event; a later set records old as the value currently in the file.

payload.question: How should set write changes back: (A) parse to locate node byte/character spans, then splice only the new text into the original file text (never re-serialize the document), or (B) ruamel.yaml round-trip load/modify/dump?

payload.final_answer: A: locate node spans with a parser and splice only the replacement text into the original file text; never re-serialize; atomic temp+rename write. Any technique is acceptable if it guarantees byte-surgical write-back; round-trip dumps are rejected.

payload.question: How should the eventsourcing history be persisted under .troupe/: (A) eventsourcing's built-in SQLite persistence module, one database file .troupe/history.sqlite, one aggregate per theatre; (B) eventsourcing POPO/in-memory recorder serialized to a JSON file; (C) other?

payload.final_answer: A: eventsourcing built-in SQLite persistence at <theatre>/.troupe/history.sqlite, one aggregate per theatre; all temp files (-journal/-wal) stay under .troupe/; seq = position in the event log.
